name: Bellingcat Online Investigation Toolkit
desc: Curated directory of OSINT geolocation, satellite, mapping and media-verification tools.

name: Google Earth / Earth Pro
desc: Global high-res satellite/aerial imagery with historical timeline for change detection.

name: Copernicus Browser (Data Space Ecosystem)
desc: Free Sentinel-1/2/3/5P browser; successor to the deprecated Sentinel Hub EO Browser.

name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
desc: EU open-access portal for full Sentinel mission archive and processing APIs.

name: NASA FIRMS (Fire/Thermal)
desc: Near-real-time active-fire/thermal hotspots from MODIS and VIIRS; useful for strikes/shelling.

name: NASA Worldview
desc: Browse 1000+ near-real-time global satellite layers (MODIS/VIIRS) day-by-day.

name: Planet Disaster / Crisis Response Data
desc: Free PlanetScope/SkySat imagery for major disasters to vetted NGO/gov responders.

name: Maxar / Vantor Open Data Program
desc: Free high-res (Maxar/Vantor) imagery released under CC BY-NC for major disaster events.

name: USGS EarthExplorer
desc: Search/download Landsat, Sentinel-2, aerial and declassified imagery archives.

name: Sentinel Hub EO Browser
desc: Legacy multispectral Sentinel/Landsat browser; deprecated, redirects to Copernicus/Planet.

name: SkyFi
desc: On-demand commercial satellite tasking and archive purchase up to 25cm, no subscription.

name: Esri World Imagery Wayback
desc: Browse every historical version of Esri World Imagery basemap for change comparison.

name: Zoom Earth
desc: Live geostationary satellite, weather radar and NASA fire/heat overlays in real time.

name: Soar (Soar Atlas)
desc: Community digital atlas aggregating satellite, drone and crowd-shared map layers.

name: OpenStreetMap
desc: Free editable world map; base layer for cross-referencing features during geolocation.

name: Overpass Turbo
desc: Query and visualize OpenStreetMap features (towers, bridges, bases) for geolocation.

name: Mapillary
desc: 3B+ crowdsourced street-level photos for ground-truth geolocation and verification.

name: Wikimapia
desc: Crowd-labeled satellite map identifying military, industrial and POI sites worldwide.

name: Yandex Maps (imagery)
desc: Strong satellite/panorama coverage over Russia/CIS; key for Eastern-front geolocation.

name: GeoConfirmed
desc: Crowdsourced map of geolocated, verified conflict footage from Ukraine, Gaza and beyond.

name: SunCalc
desc: Sun position, azimuth and shadow-length calculator for chronolocation of photos/video.

name: PeakVisor
desc: 3D mountain panorama identification to geolocate imagery by skyline/ridge matching.

name: LiveUAMap
desc: Interactive live map aggregating geotagged conflict and crisis events worldwide.

name: Sentinel Hub Playground / EO data API
desc: Cloud EO processing APIs for Sentinel/Landsat: custom scripts, NDVI, change detection.
